units.source_text: 我的眉間被迎面砍傷，從此，無論我接觸什麼樣的人，都會感到那傷口的隱痛。

en.t: I was cut head-on between the eyebrows, and from then on, no matter what kind of person I came into contact with, I felt a dull ache in that wound.

units.source_text: 「真的很同情你，不過，這一下子你也該多少體會到一點了吧。

en.t: I do feel sorry for you, but now you must understand at least a little, don't you?

units.source_text: 我不會再到你這裡來了，這裡簡直就是地獄。

en.t: I am never coming back here again. This place is nothing but hell.

units.source_text: ……你可得原諒良子啊，因為你小子也不是一個什麼好東西，我告辭了。」

en.t: But you have to forgive Yoshiko. After all, you yourself are no good either. I'll be going now.

units.source_text: 堀木才沒那麼傻，會在這樣尷尬的場面久留。

en.t: Horiki was not so foolish as to linger in such an awkward situation.

units.source_text: 我站起來，獨自喝著燒酒，開始嚎啕大哭。

en.t: I got up, drank shochu by myself, and began to sob aloud.

units.source_text: 嗓子都要哭啞了，淚水還是止不住。

en.t: Even when my throat was almost hoarse from crying, the tears would not stop.

units.source_text: 不知何時，良子端著滿滿一盤蠶豆，神情茫然地站在我的背後。

en.t: At some point, Yoshiko was standing behind me, holding a plate piled high with broad beans, her expression blank.
